_comment: Who to look for and how. Add speakers/queries here; reruns only fetch what is new. Seed lists of Michigan Democratic winners come from github.com/AndySwirczek/Election-Fallout (Nov. 4, 2026).

speakers.name: Jocelyn Benson
speakers.detail: Secretary of State; elected governor over John James. Takes office Jan. 1, 2027.

speakers.name: Abdul El-Sayed
speakers.detail: Physician and former Detroit health director; won the open U.S. Senate seat over Mike Rogers.

speakers.name: Eli Savit
speakers.detail: Washtenaw County Prosecutor; elected attorney general over Doug Lloyd.

speakers.name: Winnie Brinks
speakers.detail: Senate Majority Leader; Benson's running mate.

speakers.name: Ranjeev Puri
speakers.detail: House Minority Leader 2025-26; Democrats flipped the state House.

speakers.name: Curtis Hertel Jr.
speakers.detail: MDP chair; spoke at the Hudson's Detroit watch party.
queries: Michigan Democratic Party chair election results

speakers.name: Darrin Camilleri
speakers.detail: Assistant Senate Majority Leader 2025-26; possible Senate leadership candidate.

speakers.name: Sean McCann
speakers.detail: State senator; declared victory over Rep. Bill Huizenga.

speakers.name: William Lawrence
speakers.detail: Declared victory over Rep. Tom Barrett.

speakers.name: Christina Hines
speakers.detail: Declared victory in the open seat over Mike Bouchard.

speakers.name: Jeremy Moss

print_quotes.speaker: puri
print_quotes.setting: Election-night speech, Democratic watch party at Hudson's Detroit, Nov. 3
print_quotes.quote: I watched healthcare be ripped away from our sick. I watched food and benefits taken away from our needy, and I watched tax cuts to billionaire corporations.
print_quotes.author: Ben Solis
print_quotes.headline: Return of the trifecta: Michigan Democrats reclaim full control of state government
print_quotes.variant: The Detroit News renders it: "I've watched health care be ripped away from our sick."
print_quotes.context: Puri listed health care losses first among the harms he said he watched as minority leader under the Republican House majority.

print_quotes.speaker: puri
print_quotes.setting: Election-night speech, Democratic watch party at Hudson's Detroit, Nov. 3
print_quotes.quote: The people of Michigan spoke up tonight and said that they've had enough, and they delivered a House Democratic majority.
print_quotes.author: Ben Solis
print_quotes.headline: Return of the trifecta: Michigan Democrats reclaim full control of state government
print_quotes.context: Puri called the result not a "blue wave" but a "tsunami" and said House Democrats would protect the state from "chaos" in Washington (Detroit News).

print_quotes.speaker: camilleri
print_quotes.setting: Post-election statement as chair of the Senate Democratic Fund (setting not reported)
print_quotes.quote: Every one of our candidates left it all on the field and because of their hard work, Michiganders will have an expanded majority in the state Senate that's ready to deliver even more progress for the people of our state.
print_quotes.author: Beth LeBlanc and Craig Mauger
print_quotes.headline: Michigan Democrats ride 'blue tsunami' to control in Lansing
print_quotes.context: Camilleri credited candidates for an expanded Senate majority; he did not name health care or other specific priorities in the reported remarks.
